messages:
sasha: heads-up - found parity bug between REST and python-sdk for async embeddings. curl returns 202 + Location and job runs fine, but python-sdk raises and retries so we create duplicate async jobs. repro below.

sasha: curl (works)
```ncurl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings/async \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' \
  -d '{\"model\":\"embed-lite\",\"input\":[\"a\",\"b\"]}'
# -> HTTP/1.1 202 Accepted
# -> Location: /v1/jobs/ab12cd
```

sasha: python-sdk (fails & retries)
```nfrom redwood import RedwoodClient
c = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.getenv('KEY'))
job = c.embeddings.create_async(model=\"embed-lite\", input=[\"a\",\"b\"]) 
# raises HTTPError(\"unexpected status: 202\") and our retry loop re-sends
```

sasha: quick guess: client treats non-200 as error instead of any 2xx, and it doesn't surface Location for polling. billing sees two jobs. cc @kevin for SDK fix?

kevin: that matches support tickets. checking client/http.py now. likely spot where we did `if resp.status_code != 200: raise`.

kevin: local patch accepts 2xx and parses Location header. snippet:
```n- if resp.status_code != 200:
-     raise HTTPError(...)
+ if resp.status_code < 200 or resp.status_code >= 300:
+     raise HTTPError(...)
+ job_loc = resp.headers.get('Location')
+ if job_loc:
+     return Job.from_id(job_loc.split('/')[-1])
```

maria: nice. add an integration test that mocks 202 + Location and asserts no retry and job id returned. also ensure parity across node/go sdks.

liam: +1 on tests. customer got charged for duplicates so this should be high priority/hotfix.

maria: rollout plan: 1) patch + unit/integration tests 2) cut patch releases for python/node 3) changelog + notify support to reconcile duplicates 4) check telemetry for retry spike in last 24h

kevin: working on PR now, will include test and changelog. tagging @devex-bot.


devex-bot: Created issue #3456: "python-sdk: accept 2xx for async endpoints and parse Location header to avoid duplicate async jobs" assigned to kevin, priority: high. https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/issues/3456 :white_check_mark: 

sasha: follow-up: add a tiny e2e step in onboarding sample app to hit an async endpoint in CI so we catch regressions. low-effort high-ROI.

kevin: will add e2e step using test harness job stub and ping here when PR is up. :thumbsup:
